cases.description: Text after the first delimiter occurrence
Negative instance_num counts delimiters from the end
cases.expected_note: -1 means the last delimiter; text after it is 'c'

cases.description: Text in the instance_num position (3rd argument) is not if_not_found (6th) -> #VALUE!
cases.expected_note: Signature: TEXTAFTER(text, delimiter, [instance_num], [match_mode], [match_end], [if_not_found]). "none" here is passed as instance_num, where a number is required, so the documented result is #VALUE! -- confirmed by Excel for the web and LibreOffice 25.8. if_not_found must be the sixth argument.
